Google is working on different Writing Modes for Gemini Notebook.

- Writing Partner, as a default option, uses AI to help make notes better.
- Writing Coach acts in the chat and makes suggestions to the user. 
- No AI, for those who don't want to use it at all.

Netlify is relaunching its platform around AI agents, focusing on agentic app development and hosting.

The launch includes 150 new connectors, allowing its agents to plug into services such as Notion, Linear, or Stripe on their own. Every code change is an entry in the version
posts.quoted: New mission. New brand. New website. New Netlify. Turn your imagination into reality. Describe an app, build it with agents in a live preview, and developers and your agents can pick it up in Git or your own preferred tools. Check out @biilmann’s new video.
